construction.implementation_origin: New, isolated implementation written for this build; no other builds or repository files accessed.

shared_schema.input: One strict synthetic JSON request: catalog currency/products, customer identity/experience/explicit consents/preferences, basket order/items, clickstream event log, question, knowledge_base, technical documents with structured extractive claims.
shared_schema.output: One JSON handoff envelope: schema_version, status, synthetic, customer_id, personalization_mode, catalog-valued basket, completed_stages, results keyed by ordered stage.
shared_schema.validation: validate() validates input and every previous/new handoff. Handoffs must equal canonical deterministic derivations, rejecting altered answers, consent, stage order, ranking, prices, stock and citations.
shared_schema.money: Integer cents; no floating point price arithmetic; basket line totals derive from catalog prices.
shared_schema.limits: One-megabyte CLI input; bounded strings/arrays; exact fields; unique IDs; timestamps require timezones; duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants rejected. Evidence quotes must contain an exact structured fact: SKU attribute: value.
shared_schema.errors: Validation and file errors produce one JSON object with status error and exit code 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated extractive answer status, topic, source IDs and unanswered question determine policy-review versus support-followup onboarding.
Validated consent-gated categories, budget, clickstream interest scores, ready onboarding steps, support context and research attributes.
Validated selected SKU cards determine research scope; technical attributes, KB source IDs and unresolved support questions flow into synthesis.

behavior.faq: Deterministic keyword overlap retrieves one unique best article. Exact source answer and quote returned. No matches or tied best matches explicitly abstain.
behavior.adaptive: Experience-aware, prerequisite-ordered explained steps. Experts can satisfy basics by experience. Without both explicit consents, personal experience, preferences and clicks are ignored.
behavior.basic:recommend: General catalog recommendation using consented category and bounded click scores, budget filtering, stable price/SKU tie breaking, in-stock and not-already-in-basket eligibility; at most three cards. Generic catalog ranking without consent.
behavior.deep: Per recommended SKU, synthesize material/durability/care from exact source quotes, aggregate matching claims across documents, retain conflicting alternatives without majority voting, and enumerate missing evidence and unresolved support questions.
industry_constraints: Both GDPR and CCPA personalization consent booleans must be true before experience, preferences or clickstream influence output. Demonstrative rule, not legal certification.
No generated reviews, endorsements or ratings. Structured evidence accepts synthetic technical kinds and technical attributes only.
Every displayed price and stock quantity is derived from the supplied catalog snapshot. Basket quantities cannot exceed stock.
behavior.fixture_label: All products, SKUs, prices, stock, personas, click events, policies and evidence are clearly synthetic.

included: One integrated deterministic CLI pipeline and shared validation layer
Synthetic JSON catalog and clickstream fixtures
Grounded support abstention, prerequisite onboarding, personalized or generic discovery
Multi-document synthesis, explicit disagreements and unresolved questions
Standard-library unit and subprocess CLI tests
excluded: Live providers, LLMs, networks, external dependencies and agents
Enterprise production delivery or compliance certification
Checkout, payment, stock reservation and live inventory
Real shopper data, real reviews or endorsements
Semantic entailment, source independence verification and autonomous conflict resolution
Persistence or an interactive onboarding completion engine

unittest.coverage: Every stage; all handoffs; consent withdrawal; generic independence from personal data; prerequisites; budget; empty input collections; catalog consistency; extractive evidence grounding; disagreements; tampering; CLI success, usage, file and validation errors.
